subject: MAP closure playbook — performance evidence kit & exec snapshot
messages:
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.ai>
To: Daniel Brooks <daniel.brooks@helion.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 12 Jan 2027 14:20:00 -0800
Subject: MAP: performance evidence kit & next steps

Hi Daniel —

Following our call this morning, attaching the proposed evidence kit we'll deliver as part of the MAP. The goal is to have everything you need to validate latency and throughput claims ahead of your Q3 pilot signoff. High level:

- Deliverables (by Jan 20):
  - Slide deck (executive + test summary) — helion_map_execution_plan_v2.pdf
  - Raw CSV exports (latency/throughput/TTFT per concurrency run) — helion_latency_throughput_q3.csv
  - Prebuilt Grafana dashboard snapshot + share link
  - Executive one-pager for your stakeholders

- Test scope: multi-AZ, steady-state concurrency at 8/16/32, TTFT and p99/p95 latency, token/sec throughput.
- Acceptance criteria: p95 < 300ms for 8 concurrency; throughput >= 400 tokens/s sustained at 16 concurrency; no failures > 0.1% over 30m windows.

Can you confirm: (1) these artifacts map to what your procurement / SRE reviewers need, and (2) who will attend the exec readout on Jan 20 for the final close conversation?

Attachments: helion_map_execution_plan_v2.pdf (slides), helion_latency_throughput_q3.csv (CSV stub)

Thanks — I’ll loop Marissa and Karthik for delivery coordination.

—
Sofia Ivanova
Director, Solutions — Redwood Inference
sofia.ivanova@redwood.ai
(415) 555-0198
From: Daniel Brooks <daniel.brooks@helion.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 13 Jan 2027 10:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MAP: performance evidence kit & next steps

Sofia —

Thanks for the summary. A couple of asks from our side before you lock the artifacts:

1) Can you include separate CSVs for each concurrency sweep (so we can ingest into our pipeline)? Helion SRE prefers per-run files rather than a single combined file.
2) TTFT definition — please include the client-side measurement points (when request leaves their client) vs server-side. We need to map to our SIEM.
3) For the exec readout: our VP of Platform, Lena Ortiz, wants a 15–20 minute top-line brief followed by a quick Q&A. Can you confirm time window Jan 20? We are PT.

Also: please cc our ops alias ops@helion.com when you share the Grafana link.

Daniel
Daniel Brooks
Head of Integrations — Helion Cloud

Hi Daniel — thanks, noted. Quick plan:

- We'll produce per-run CSVs (file naming: helion_latency_concurrency_8.csv, helion_latency_concurrency_16.csv, helion_latency_concurrency_32.csv).
- TTFT will be captured both client-side and server-side; we'll include a short methodology appendix in the deck and a one-page mapping table for your SIEM fields.
- Proposed exec readout slot: Jan 20, 11:00–11:30 PT (15 min brief + 10 min Q&A). If that doesn't work, offer two alternatives: 09:30 PT or 15:00 PT.

Links: HubSpot deal — https://hubspot.com/deals/DEAL-9347; Shared Drive folder (initial drafts) — https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2bHelionMAP

I'll attach the current draft slide deck and the preliminary CSVs (zipped) for your SRE to scan.

Attachments: helion_map_execution_plan_v2.pdf, helion_latency_throughput_q3.csv (prelim)

Thanks — Marissa

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Daniel Brooks <daniel.brooks@helion.com>
Cc: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 15 Jan 2027 08:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MAP: performance evidence kit & next steps

Marissa / Daniel —

Adding a couple technical details we'll include in the methodology appendix so Helion's SREs can reproduce the tests:

- Load generation: k6 (v0.42) with tokenized payloads; seed traffic for 5 minutes before each sweep; 30 minute steady-state window per concurrency point.
- KV cache: warmed with 10K unique prompts to remove cold-start bias; we will surface cache-hit ratios in the CSVs.
- Measurement points: client-send timestamp, server-receive timestamp, server-send timestamp, client-receive timestamp; TTFT = client-receive - client-send.
- Failure classification: distinguish 5xx, timeouts, and tokenization errors; include per-minute failure counts.

We'll also export a Grafana snapshot (grafana_dashboard_snapshot.png) and provide a live viewer link (read-only) with ops@helion.com added.

Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Principal Performance Engineer — Redwood Inference
